prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept / image edit. The current portrait is identity-authoritative. The already adopted knight and healer portraits are drawing-style references only. Optimize the supplied character as one coherent member of that same illustrated game roster.

Preserve species, gender, character identity, main color scheme, distinctive equipment, pose direction and full silhouette. Keep weapons, wings, tails and feet fully inside the portrait. Preserve the specific previous costume and gesture choices; do not transfer clothing, ornaments, species or poses from the references.

Rendering: refined 2D Japanese anime game illustration with controlled volume and clean cel-shaded forms. Clearly visible dark slightly thicker outer contours, medium structural overlap lines, fine sparse interior lines. Smooth intentional taper. Strong silhouette definition like the adopted references, without a uniform sticker stroke. Keep depth, appealing nuanced anime faces and a few meaningful material highlights; do not flatten into a generic cartoon or make a photorealistic / 3D render.

Humanoid anatomy: balanced adult proportions, natural head-to-shoulder and torso-to-leg relationship, readable hands, grounded stance; no tiny head, elongated thighs, pinched pelvis or distorted joints. Adult men have clean appealing East Asian anime features appropriate to their age and role, neither oily western realism nor effeminate identical faces. Nonhuman creatures remain nonhuman; machinery remains machinery.

Hair: organized large masses and a small number of clear locks, tidy silhouette, only a few purposeful loose strands. Cloth: broad continuous matte color areas, a few folds where tension, joints and gravity require them; no patchwork shadow blocks or dozens of decorative creases. White cloth stays white with restrained soft shadows. Armor: physically coherent plates, clear joins and limited grouped highlights; retain necessary signature ornament, remove invented gratuitous metal flourishes, micro-engraving, sparkling bits and layered filigree. Do not convert cloth into metal. Creature surfaces and mechanical parts follow the same line hierarchy and coherent restrained shading while keeping required anatomy and functional structure.

Background: opaque low-saturation softly graded color field matched to the character palette. Mid-dark overall, gently lighter behind the head and upper body, deeper near edges and lower corners, restrained foot contact shadow. Choose a subtle gray undertone that separates character colors: slate blue-gray, smoky gray-violet, muted sage-gray or warm charcoal/taupe. Uniform collection treatment, quiet broad forms. No scenery, architecture, foliage, clouds, smoke, particles, symbolic backdrop, magic circles, text, watermark, border, bokeh, grain, noise or photographic lighting. Existing character-specific weapon energy may remain, but no added environment effects or new rim lighting.

Portrait composition 2:3, target 1024x1536. One character only. Retain enough breathing room around signature silhouette and weapons. The supplied unit is the content; references provide only drawing quality and background treatment.

Input images: Image 1 is edit target and identity authority; Image 2 provides drawing style only. This character is a tall muscular bipedal nonhuman dragon warrior, with reptilian long snout, cyan eye, dark charcoal underside, deep turquoise-green scales, branching turquoise horns, existing ivory-gold bone spikes, crystal-like teal spines down neck and spine, two clawed arms, two digitigrade legs and enormous curling tail to viewer right. No wings in this design; do not add wings, clothing, jewelry, weapons or human face. Keep turned stance facing viewer left and curled tail shape. The green armor-like surfaces are organic scales and natural bone, not engraved manufactured armor. Simplify tiny repetitive scale shading into broad groups while retaining believable reptile anatomy and signature spines. Strong dark tapered contours with a few restrained turquoise and ivory highlights, not photoreal shiny CGI. Background low-saturation mid-dark warm charcoal-taupe with subtly lighter upper center and dark edges. Entire horn tips, tail tip, fingers and talons visible within 2:3.

Finishing pass:
Use case: style-transfer finishing edit. Image 1 is optimized teal dragon warrior, exact content and pose authority. Image 2 is adopted healer ONLY for bold drawing line hierarchy and restrained material rendering.
Repaint the DRAGON's contours and scale surfaces. This needs a very visible drawing improvement: near-black outer contour about4–5px at1024width, taper at horn/spine tips, medium overlap lines under arms and tail, thin sparse internal scale seams. Increase the outer silhouette ink substantially like Image2. Its current line is too faint.
Reduce scattered scale highlights decisively: group green scales into large readable light/shadow masses across torso, thighs, forearms and tail. Keep etched scale boundary patterns lightly where needed for reptile skin but give neighboring scales coherent common shading rather than bright individual mirrored facets. Each broad body region has one moderate highlight mass and one dark plane; no dozens of disconnected cream-white/teal glints. Gold natural bone spines get at most a single simple broad highlight each. Organic satin/matte scales, not shiny chrome/metal or polygon mosaics. Preserve rich volume and varied scale sizes, refined2D anime game illustration, not generic flat cartoon.
Everything else remains the exact dragon: entirely nonhuman reptilian face, branching green horns, green/charcoal palette, ivory bone spikes, existing two arms and digitigrade legs, curled tail, gaze/pose, full talons and warm charcoal-taupe graded background. No human hair, healer dress, jewelry or new anatomy. Keep all horns and tail tips inside2:3portrait with margins. Strong clean external ink is the main requested change.
visual_notes: Preserves nonhuman green/charcoal bipedal dragon, branching horns, ivory bone spikes, digitigrade feet and curled tail.
Second pass substantially strengthens near-black external contour and joins adjacent scale light/shadow masses, reducing disconnected shiny facets.
Warm charcoal-taupe graded background retained. Full horn/tail/claw silhouette intact.
